channel.title: HiRISE: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (NASA)
channel.description: Updates from the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO/NASA). We are based at the University of Arizona in Tucson, Ariz.

item.title: HiPOD: Rhythmic Layering in Arabia Terra
item.description: The Arabia Terra region on Mars has light-toned layered deposits exposed within larger impact craters that preserve a record of the planet’s ancient climate. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
